verdict.rationale: Convex offers an official MCP server so AI agents can inspect/query deployments in natural language, plus agent-setup guidance and messaging that it 'works great with coding agents' for scaffolding projects via natural-language requests. However, this relies entirely on external coding agents/MCP clients rather than a built-in NL interface, and production access is restricted by default. Missing for 10: a first-party conversational/NL interface within Convex itself, and independent hands-on evidence of natural-language operation succeeding end-to-end.
